about: MFM theme music library. Royalty-free instrumentals made for @melaninfitmen. The Sunday/Wednesday build picks a track per post by theme before generating anything new.

themes.cookout-food-debate: upbeat feel-good soul / hip hop with horns, ~90-100 bpm (fish fry, cookout, Be Honest food debates, family humor)
themes.cold-morning-walk: warm, slow acoustic piano + soft strings, ~75 bpm (walks, cold mornings, quiet discipline)
themes.sleep-body-facts: calm ambient lo-fi, soft keys, ~70 bpm (sleep, body/science facts, Do this / Your body does this)
themes.family-holiday: warm gospel-tinged soul, organ + claps, ~90 bpm (Thanksgiving, Sunday dinner, Your Son Is Watching, Dear Dad)
themes.training-motivation: steady motivational hip hop, punchy drums, ~95 bpm (lifting, Couch Dad Asks, workouts)
